Visitor reformats links using template interpolation

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorCustomLinkFormat struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorCustomLinkFormat) VisitLink(ctx htmd.NodeContext, href string, text string, title *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`%s (%s)`, text, href))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorCustomLinkFormat{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Visit <a href="https://example.com">Example</a> for more info.</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
